title: Historical CFGI terminal lifecycle reconciliation
objective: Reconcile the historical CFGI enrichment lifecycle with the already-ratified provider-terminal state so an unavailable MARKET historical series is not repeatedly treated as a recoverable active failure. Preserve all paid-data guards and prohibit any additional automatic paid retry.

evidence.summary: Historical enrichment latest-run failure was still represented as actionable red in automation health.
MARKET-only gapfill explicitly fails when provider returns no MARKET rows and writes FAIL_PROVIDER_DID_NOT_RETURN_MARKET before raising CFGI_MARKET_GAPFILL_PROVIDER_RETURN_INVALID.
Existing terminal finalizer ratifies NOT_TESTABLE_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, TERMINAL_PROVIDER_NO_HISTORICAL_ROWS and no_additional_paid_retry_authorized=true without paid calls.
Fresh main used to freeze this intake candidate.

forbidden_changes: any new paid retry or automatic paid retry
CFGI budget increase or reserve reduction
fabrication, interpolation or substitution of missing MARKET historical rows
resetting or deleting cumulative credit/attempt ledgers
weakening the provider-bounded v3.1 no-lookahead contract
market gates, model weights, portfolio logic or canonical market semantics
reproduction: On fresh main, the legacy enrichment path still calls cfgi_targeted_backfill.py. When the provider returns zero MARKET rows, the script writes a failed MARKET gapfill billing receipt and raises CFGI_MARKET_GAPFILL_PROVIDER_RETURN_INVALID. The repository also contains a terminal finalizer that explicitly accepts the bounded state as TERMINAL_PROVIDER_NO_HISTORICAL_ROWS, records no_additional_paid_retry_authorized=true and produces provider-bounded readiness without paid calls. Reconcile these states so terminal provider unavailability is not routed as a recoverable red workflow failure.

positive: A durable terminal receipt with TERMINAL_PROVIDER_NO_HISTORICAL_ROWS and no_additional_paid_retry_authorized=true is recognized as terminal/no-op rather than recoverable retry work.
Automation health or lifecycle output distinguishes terminal provider unavailability from an executable code failure.
A genuinely complete, already-idempotent enrichment remains valid without new paid calls.
Provider-bounded v3.1 readiness remains research-only with automatic_promotion=false.
negative: No code path introduced by this repair may issue a new paid MARKET gapfill after terminalization.
No missing MARKET rows may be fabricated, interpolated, copied from BTC/ETH or inferred.
Credit ledgers, hard caps and minimum reserves may not be reset or weakened.
A non-terminal transport/code failure must not be silently relabeled terminal merely to make health green.

clean_noop_condition: Fresh main already prevents all paid retries after terminalization and current Automation Health no longer reports the terminalized workflow as recoverable red.
stop_condition: Stop without implementation if current lifecycle already resolves the health signature, or if remediation would require another paid request, changing research semantics, fabricating data or weakening budget/provenance gates.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if resolution would change required observed symbols, no-lookahead semantics, budgets, provider contracts or any market/portfolio authority.
rollback_plan: Revert only lifecycle/health reconciliation changes. Preserve terminal receipts and all historical billing/attempt ledgers unchanged.
